scientific_limitations: Only finite connected simple graphs of girth at least six with at least one six-cycle and pairwise edge-disjoint six-cycle edge sets.
Only the unit-edge shortest-path metric on vertices and inclusive threshold two; no general statement for other scales or the geometric metric graph.
Claims a homotopy classification and integral homology only, not an equivariant or functorial collapse of the full Rips complex.
An independent scientific audit has not been performed; no global novelty certification is claimed.
title: A hexagon-packing classification of scale-two graph Rips complexes
